results.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel hope election results bring change
results.content: Palestinian citizens of Israel expressed optimism on Wednesday following the strong showing of Arab parties in the elections.

results.title: Recreatrales festival transforms Ouagadougou neighbourhood
results.content: In Ouagadougou, an entire neighbourhood brings the Récréâtrales theatre festival to life. For its 14th edition, running from October 24 to 31, residents of Bougsemtenga are hosting performances in their courtyards.

results.title: Africa Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases, mostly in DR Congo
results.content: Africa's latest outbreak of Ebola has passed 10,000 confirmed cases, the vast majority of them in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Congolese health authorities said on Tuesday, with almost 5,000 fatalities.

results.title: King Charles III's Caribbean tour renews calls for UK slavery reparations
results.content: The British king begins a tour of the Caribbean today, during which he will visit several former British colonies. It has renewed calls for the UK to apologies and pay reparations for its role in the slave trade.

results.title: Oil slick from Strait of Hormuz reaches UAE's northern coast
results.content: An oil slick from a tanker attacked in the Strait of Hormuz has reached the United Arab Emirates.

results.title: Spain: Rescuers search mangled train wreckage near Toledo
results.content: At least 68 people have been killed and dozens more injured after two high-speed trains collided near Urda, in central Spain’s Toledo province, on Wednesday, 28 October. Authorities warned the toll could rise further as rescuers searched the wreckage.

results.title: Humanitarian situation worsening in Sudan's camps for displaced people
results.content: Displaced and official at Al-Karama 3 camp in the city of El-Damazin in Sudan's Blue Nile state say the humanitarian conditions are deteriorating in the camp, as war rages in the country. "The camp hasn't received any food aid for four months now," says the camp's manager.

results.title: Bolsonaro’s son and family flee to Miami after refusing to concede
results.content: Flávio Bolsonaro and his family landed in Miami on Monday after leaving Brazil, following his defeat in the presidential election.

results.title: Britain's King Charles III attends youth rally in the Bahamas
results.content: Britain’s King Charles III on Tuesday addressed a youth gathering at Clifford Park in Nassau, recalling the Bahamas’ independence celebrations in 1973 and highlighting the country’s cultural achievements and vulnerability to climate change.

results.title: South Sudan independence figure Joseph Lagu dies aged 94
results.content: South Sudan is observing national mourning on Wednesday following the death of Joseph Lagu, a key figure in the independence of the world's youngest country, who told AFP that he began his fight armed with only "a machete".

results.title: Tanzania announces first major gas discovery in a decade
results.content: Tanzania has announced its first natural gas discovery in a decade, with an estimated 223 billion cubic feet found at the Kasa-1X ST2 well in the Mnazi Bay area.

results.title: South African activists push back on data centre rush
results.content: Civil society groups have demanded a halt in the construction of new AI centres in South Africa. The prospect of a water- and power-hungry hyperscale data centre near areas of the city where thousands of people lack proper access to these resources has alarmed activists.

results.title: Russia's President Putin hosts counterparts from Mozambique, Libya and Equatorial Guinea
results.content: Russian President Vladimir Putin met for talks with counterparts from Mozambique, Libya and Equatorial Guinea in Moscow on Tuesday following the Gas Exporting Countries Forum.

results.title: Nigeria's Dangote oil refinery closes 'historic' IPO
results.content: Africa's largest ever initial public offering closed on Wednesday after raising funds from investors in 120 countries. The IPO for Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery was extended by two weeks to allow more Africans to participate.

results.title: Spain: First footage reveals wreckage of deadly high-speed train crash
results.content: At least 10 people died when a high-speed train struck another near Toledo, Spain. Two carriages derailed, leaving rescuers searching through the wreckage as authorities warned the death toll could rise.

results.title: Whereabouts of Brazil's defeated presidential candidate Bolsonaro unknown
results.content: The whereabouts of Brazil's defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro were unknown on Wednesday after reports that he fled the country. Bolsonaro lost the runoff election to incumbent Luis Inacio Lula da Silva on Sunday but has refused to concede defeat.

results.title: No clear winner in Israel's first election since Hamas attack in 2023
results.content: The vote has widely been seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s handling of the conflict, with turnout the highest in decades.

results.title: Judge throws out attempted murder case against Zimbabwe VP's ex-wife
results.content: After 7 years on remand, the ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice president walked out of a Harare prison on Tuesday after a judge ordered her release. Marry Mubaiwa had been accused of attempting to murder her former husband Constantino Chiwenga in 2019.

results.title: Sana'a factory in flames as Houthis, government forces exchange strikes
results.content: Houthi media reported that Saudi-backed government forces have launched airstrikes on a "Hamdan" cement factory in Sana'a on Tuesday.

results.title: Brazil: Lula celebrates 81st birthday after re-election victory
results.content: Brazil's re-elected President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva celebrated his 81st birthday on Tuesday, 27 October, with dozens of supporters outside the Alvorada presidential palace in Brasília, just two days after winning a closely contested election.

results.title: Ukraine: massive fire engulfs buildings after Russian strike on Kharkiv
results.content: Five people, including a 4-year-old child, were injured in an overnight Russian drone strike on Kharkiv. The attack set several buildings ablaze, with firefighters working under the threat of further strikes.

results.title: Senegal's finance committee to review revised budget key to IMF deal
results.content: The country has been grappling with a debt burden that the IMF says had reached 132 per cent of gross domestic product by ⁠the end of 2024.

results.title: Iranian president says Middle East can solve its problems without United States
results.content: Masoud Pezeshkian made the comments during talks with Russia's President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum in Moscow.

results.title: Israel: opposition supporters celebrate narrow lead in exit polls
results.content: Supporters of Gadi Eisenkot celebrated in Tel Aviv as exit polls gave Israel's opposition bloc a narrow lead over Benjamin Netanyahu's camp, but no outright parliamentary majority.

results.title: Portugal: Lisbon housing crisis sparks protest outside parliament
results.content: Demonstrators gathered outside Portugal's parliament to protest against the housing crisis and police violence during recent camp clearances. The president has called for dialogue while defending police actions.

results.title: Mbappe apologises for Mao Zedong comment after Chinese sponsors drop him
results.content: Football superstar Kylian Mbappé has apologised after a video appearing to show him joking about Chinese leader Mao Zedong sparked outrage in China.

results.title: South Africa claims 7.6 kilometre-long freight train is the longest ever
results.content: A government-run company in South Africa claims that it has sent the longest freight train ever on a test run.

results.title: Botanists comb Gabon's rich rainforests with nature on the line
results.content: Each year, Gabon's lush rainforests yield the discovery of previously unknown plant species to botanists like Archange Boupoya, who believes that this exceptional yet largely mysterious natural wealth needs cataloguing to save.

results.title: Poor jail conditions blamed for deaths of 33 miners in Nigeria
results.content: Poor jail conditions led to the deaths of 33 young miners arrested on suspicion of illegal gold mining in central Nigeria, investigators said Tuesday, describing their treatment as “cruel and inhuman.”
